inlines.v: BED'LAM, noun [Corrupted from Bethlehem, the name of a religious house in London, afterward converted into a hospital for lunatics.] 1. A mad house; a place appropriated for lunatics.] 2. A madman; a lunatic; one who lives in bedlam 3. A place of uproar. BED'LAM, adjective Belonging to a mad house; fit for a mad house.
